program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define row-filled
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
        (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
          (let ((cols (map second
                           (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color))
                                   (for/list ([c (in-range (cols g))]) (list r c (at g r c)))))))
            (if (and (= (length cols) 2)
                     (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0))
                           (range (+ (apply min cols) 1) (apply max cols))))
                (paint-cells acc
                  (for/list ([c (in-range (apply min cols) (+ (apply max cols) 1))]) (list r c))
                  color)
                acc)))))
    (for/fold ([out row-filled]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
      (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
        (let ((rs (map first
                       (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color))
                               (for/list ([r (in-range (rows g))]) (list r c (at g r c)))))))
          (if (and (= (length rs) 2)
                   (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 0))
                         (range (+ (apply min rs) 1) (apply max rs))))
              (paint-cells acc
                (for/list ([r (in-range (apply min rs) (+ (apply max rs) 1))]) (list r c))
                color)
              acc))))))
